config.method: LoRA SFT then group-relative clipped policy gradient on constrained action tokens
config.action_space: 13 displayed bounded tool/parameter candidates; same for all groups

limitations: single training seed, 24 held-out synthetic cases
constrained candidate action/parameter selection, not free-form tool generation
known tool/fault families with held-out numeric combinations, not unseen task families
live multi-system acceptance is separate and not part of held-out scores
4B and previous domain RL weights unchanged
8 regression questions are not broad retention proof

audit.source: summary.json and per-case raw decision/action logs

metrics.recovery_rate: all assigned fault cases, including failures before reaching the fault
metrics.parameter_accuracy: exact match of all three requested parameters / all parameter attempts, regardless of other execution preconditions; null if none
metrics.parameter_execution_success_rate: parameter attempts accepted with their execution preconditions / all attempts

audit.tolerance_reason: training uses Python 3.9 and audit uses Python 3.12; float-sum algorithms can differ at machine precision; individual step rewards remain exact
